🇩🇪 A1 GERMAN VOCABULARY: Restaurant (At a restaurant)

die Serviette = napkin
das Besteck = cutlery
der Tisch = table
das Restaurant = restaurant
die Speisekarte = menu
der Kellner = waiter

💡 Tip: Learn der/die/das with every noun.
